Package com.egradx.redis

package com.egradx.redis
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    EgradxRedisAttemptLimiter
    Counts wrong passwords in Redis, so every instance counts together: the same sliding window, limits and waits as EgradxInMemoryAttemptLimiter, kept in two sorted sets per guess (contracts/redis).
    EgradxRedisAutoConfiguration
    Adding egradx-redis to an application with a Redis server (spring.data.redis.*) makes its instances act as one: it replaces egradx-auth's in-memory attempt limiter and egradx-notification's local push broadcaster, and relays role changes to every instance's cache.
    EgradxRedisFailures
    What happens when Redis fails: nothing fails with it.
    EgradxRedisProperties
    egradx.redis.*.
    EgradxRedisPushBroadcaster
    Pushes every in-app notification live on every instance: it is published on <prefix>notification:published, and each instance, this one included, hands what it receives to its own live streams (contracts/redis).
    EgradxRedisRoleAuthoritiesRelay
    Tells every instance when a role's authorities change, so each evicts it from its own egradx-role-authorities cache at once — not when the entry expires (60 s by default).
    EgradxRedisSubscriptions
    This instance's subscriptions, started in the background.
